item.title: No. 3 Michigan’s defense stifles Indiana in dominant 86-72 victory
item.description: Michigan defeated Indiana 86-72, with Elliot Cadeau leading the way with 19 points. Indiana's Lamar Wilkerson was held to a season-low 8 points.

item.title: Bulldogs’ Finley Bizjack scores 24 as Butler defeats DePaul in Big East matchup
item.description: Finley Bizjack had 24 points in Butler's 87-80 win over DePaul on Tuesday night. Layden Blocker led the Blue Demons with 20 points.

item.title: 2 eviction programs are merging in Indianapolis
item.description: Two free programs in Indianapolis and Lawrence Township that help people facing eviction are merging in an effort to provide more resources to tenants, although there are concerns about a lack of staff and navigators in court.

item.title: Bill allowing childhood ‘independent activities’ clears Indiana House
item.description: (INDIANA CAPITAL CHRONICLE) — Indiana House members voted unanimously in favor of a bill that would shield Hoosier parents from child welfare investigations based solely for allowing their children age-appropriate independence. item.title: Warmer with rain-snow mix chance Wednesday, next arctic blast in sight | Jan. 20, 2026
item.description: A brief return to above-normal temperatures is expected Wednesday with rain-snow chances before an arctic blast slides in with snow potential from a potentially strong system, bringing frigid temperatures and subzero wind chills this weekend.

item.title: ULCA Bruins snap No. 4 Purdue’s 9-game win streak with late 3-pointer
item.description: UCLA rallied to edge No. 4 Purdue 69-67, snapping the Boilermakers' nine-game winning streak with a go-ahead 3-pointer from Tyler Bilodeau in the final eight seconds.

item.title: Teacher accused of forcing students to give foot massages at Fishers school
item.description: Parents of three Hamilton Southeastern elementary school students have filed a tort claim alleging a teacher forced their children to rub her feet. The school district is accused of negligence for not supervising the students and for hiring, retaining, and not supervising the teacher.

item.title: Search continues for missing Fishers teen Hailey Buzbee, police release new details
item.description: Fishers Police Department is continuing to search for Hailey Buzbee, who has been missing since January 5th, and believe she did not act alone in leaving.
